note: Fides cookie consent banner -- renders: operator's fixed privacy policy copy, 'Manage Preferences', 'Reject All', 'Accept All', and language options
Site masthead -- renders: operator's fixed navigation labels, section names, and search controls
Site index landmark -- renders: operator's fixed section labels
Site footer -- renders: operator's fixed legal links, contact info, and navigation
Tab navigation bar -- renders: operator's fixed tab labels (e.g., 'Latest', 'Popular')
Pagination controls -- renders: operator's fixed page numbers and next/previous links
Content section headers -- renders: operator's fixed section titles and 'See All' links
Collection header -- renders: operator's fixed collection title and sub-section navigation links
Social media links -- renders: operator's fixed links to official social profiles
